tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Brand charcoal. The ground of the dark theme and the ink of the light theme. Never use as a tint of grey.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Brand cream. The ground of the light theme and the ink of the dark theme. Warm paper, not white.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand burnt orange, exact. For the 'ai' in the wordmark, the eye pupil, rules, large display type (24px+) and graphic marks (3:1 or better on both grounds). Not for text under 24px: it is 4.4:1 on charcoal and 3.4:1 on cream.

tokens.name: orange-bright
tokens.usage: Accessible orange for the dark theme: small accent text on charcoal (5.6:1) and fills that carry charcoal text. Derived from the brand orange for contrast only.

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Accessible orange for the light theme: small accent text on cream (4.8:1) and fills that carry cream text. Derived from the brand orange for contrast only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Body copy in ink reads on it at 15:1 (dark) and 15:1 (light).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs sitting on surface. Ink and ink-muted both pass 4.5:1 here.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and mono labels on surface and surface-raised (6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers. Too faint to mark a control: use line-strong for input and button borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls and any outline that carries meaning (3:1 on surface in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent text, links and the focus ring on surface and surface-raised. 5.6:1 on dark, 4.8:1 on light.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and selected states. Always pair with on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill: charcoal on bright orange (5.6:1), cream on deep orange (4.8:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The exact brand orange for marks, rules and the 'ai' of the wordmark. Graphics and display type only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero statements and covers. Weight 200, lowercase, one or two lines.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Speed-asymmetric delivery for studios and startups

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We deliver in days what agencies quote in weeks.
styles.usage: Running copy at 16px and above. Weight 300.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Captions, helper text and table cells.
styles.usage: Anything under 16px steps up to weight 400 so thin strokes stay readable.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, tags and section markers. Always in ink-muted or accent.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap, card padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Control padding (horizontal), card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Group spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section inner spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: buttons, cards, inputs, images. The brand is sharp-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Only where a pure 0 clips a focus ring or a screen edge. Use sparingly.
